description: This file defines a base interface and associated models for connector implementations within a larger software system. It includes capabilities, descriptors, authentication models, request/response schemas for search and creation operations, metadata handling, and a Protocol class that all connector implementations should conform to. The file is designed to facilitate integration with external services like Jira or Confluence, and emphasizes extensibility and uniformity for connector implementations.

classes.name: Capability
classes.description: Enum representing high-level capabilities (search, create, metadata) supported by connectors.

classes.name: ConnectorDescriptor
classes.description: Model describing connector metadata including key, name, supported auth strategies, capabilities, and optional URLs/icons.

classes.name: OAuthConfig
classes.description: Model for OAuth-specific configuration parameters needed at runtime.

classes.name: ApiKeyConfig
classes.description: Model for API key-based authentication configuration.

classes.name: AuthConfig
classes.description: Union type for either OAuthConfig or ApiKeyConfig.

classes.name: SearchRequest
classes.description: Parameters for submitting a search query to the connector.

classes.name: SearchItem
classes.description: Representation of individual search result item.

classes.name: SearchResponse
classes.description: Response model containing list of search items and pagination cursor.

classes.name: CreateRequest
classes.description: Parameters for creating a new entity via connector.

classes.name: CreateResponse
classes.description: Response containing details of created entity.

classes.name: MetadataRequest
classes.description: Parameters for fetching metadata resources such as projects or spaces.

classes.name: MetadataItem
classes.description: Representation of a single metadata resource.

classes.name: MetadataResponse
classes.description: Model containing list of metadata items.

classes.name: BaseConnector
classes.description: Protocol interface that all connector classes should implement, defining methods like descriptor, auth strategies, search, create, metadata, and helper methods for auth and headers.

methods.name: ConnectorDescriptor descriptor(self)
methods.description: Returns a ConnectorDescriptor advertising capabilities and support details.

methods.name: List[AuthStrategy] auth_strategies(self)
methods.description: Returns list of supported AuthStrategy enums.

methods.name: SearchResponse search(self, req: SearchRequest)
methods.description: Executes a search operation based on SearchRequest and returns SearchResponse.

methods.name: CreateResponse create(self, req: CreateRequest)
methods.description: Creates a new entity based on CreateRequest, returning CreateResponse.

methods.name: MetadataResponse metadata(self, req: MetadataRequest)
methods.description: Fetches metadata resources like projects or spaces, returning MetadataResponse.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] apply_auth(self, headers: Dict[str, str], *, auth: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Adds authentication info to HTTP headers based on provided auth credentials.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] default_headers(self)
methods.description: Provides default headers for HTTP requests.

methods.name: Optional[str] base_url_from_metadata(self, metadata: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Extracts the base URL for API calls from stored connection metadata.
